verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app with no AI or agent component, so acting as an MCP client that uses tools from MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
